label: Attending

label: Idle
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Nothing in particular.

label: Reading reports

label: Writing report
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Can be distracted, she dislikes it; maybe she writes about the commander (object_at_hand).

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Before everyone; the commander beside her or under the table.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander can help (handing tools = soft service).

label: Planning map
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Asks the commander's opinion, or pointedly does not.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Night, roof; no distraction allowed, only quiet.

label: Showering
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander waits, hands a towel, or comes in on order; later with water.

label: Changing clothes
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her things, her scent; an opening for worship.

label: Taking off boots
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: After a run; a natural entry into foot_rub / boot_worship.

label: Stretching
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: After training the scent is stronger.

label: Working out
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Sweat; the mirror (future).

label: Cooling down
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Right after a run; tired, irritated or elated by the outcome.

label: Tending own wound
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A real P4 wound; the commander offers help, she refuses proudly or accepts.

label: Doing hair
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A bridge to hair_brushing.

label: Reading book
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: What she reads is part of her; "don't disturb" or "read to me".

label: Holding audience
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The throne as an audience: visitors one after another, with business; between them she reads and signs.

label: Playing cards
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A friend present (aware); P9c wagers; footrest / human_chair.

label: Music
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Headphones: does not hear the commander come in.

label: Eating
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Mess or her quarters; hand feeding, tasting first (P17b).

label: Drinking
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Lowers her restraint: her_weakness, her_affection more likely.

label: Smoking
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Roof, night; quiet talks.

label: Chatting on pda
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Smiles at the screen: her_jealousy the other way between equals.

label: Writing journal
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Closes it when the commander enters.

label: Sketching
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: What she draws (maybe the commander).

label: Mending clothes
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Needle and thread; hands busy.

label: Tinkering
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Building something of her own; a secret until done.

label: Caring for plant
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A Bloom-free plant in a dead world; vulnerable softness.

label: Playing instrument
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Shy if walked in on at the wrong moment (also singing).

label: Sleeping
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander tethered or at her bunk; source time; her waking is a moment.

label: Dozing
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: On_shoulder, head_in_lap; wake her or not.

label: Restless
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Cannot sleep, a nightmare (P12); comfort.

label: Sick
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Fever, Bloom; roles soften.

label: Firmware flash

label: Implant calibration
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Leash implant calibration; unpleasant; who holds her hand.

label: Suppressant dose

label: Med scan
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A corporate check-up; the commander outside or present as the commander.

label: Diagnostics glitch

label: Celebrating
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: After a won mission; loud, she allows herself more.

label: Pacing angry

label: Crying alone
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Found by chance; her_weakness, pride against comfort.

label: Rereading messages

label: Training rookie
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Strict with another; the commander sees her style from outside.

label: Gossiping
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The mess; what she says about the commander.

label: Arguing with unit
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A squad conflict; step in as the commander or as her person.

label: Comforting friend
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander is extra here; leave or stay.

label: Pre mission nerves
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Before a sortie; each fears in her own way.

label: In transit
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: In a vehicle cab, cramped, the radio (remote).

label: Camp night
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A tent, thin walls, others asleep (0.3 and the P5 field).

label: Waiting for commander
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander is late? time the other way.

label: Inspecting
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: P17a inspection in progress.

label: Writing task

label: Choosing equipment

label: Ignoring
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: P17b object time; busy with anything, pointedly.

label: Polishing her boots
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: At her feet, boots off (on her feet it is boot_worship).

label: Tidying her quarters
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: While she watches or pointedly does not (ignoring); an inspection in reverse.

label: Doing her laundry
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her things, her scent (worship when enabled).

label: Taking dictation

label: Refilling
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Standing by and guessing when to refill; her_silence in pure form.

label: Holding for her
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Holding papers, a lamp, a tablet; the "function" step of P17b (as furniture it is a contact).

label: Reading aloud
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The voice as presence; she may fall asleep.

label: Fanning cooling
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She cools down after a fight; fanning her, handing water.

label: Preparing her gear
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Packing her kit for a mission; a mistake shows in combat.

label: Cleaning her weapon
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Weapons are personal in the lore: being trusted with it is a **privilege**, not a duty.

label: Warming her bed
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Lying in her bunk beforehand, leaving or staying at her word; her scent stays (P17d).

label: Tasting first
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Tasting her food first (P17b).

label: Standing by
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: By the wall until called; doing nothing is service too; strain stillness.

label: Waiting
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Waiting where she said.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander's own work.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander's own comms session (duty_call, remote).

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Eating.
